programmes.d: Renegade Natives led by a white man named Clay threaten the residents of a decommissioned fort.
A frontier couple battle Natives, outlaws and a government-issued land grant to save their ranch.
Gold fever takes hold when Nellie learns that nuggets just lay on the ground in a remote area of Mexico.
Best friends recently out of the U.S. Army use a card game to determine an important decision about marriage.
Two outlaws devise a mining operation and finance it with stolen bullion.
Mormons must save the life of a dying man or face the wrath of his tribe.
A Mormon leaves the church and takes the name Butch Cassidy.
To avenge his son's death, an embittered rancher sets out to destroy a cowtown.
Lucia Darling moves to Montana to start a school but faces many challenges.
The honeymoon is over when Jim Dayton's wife stumbles onto his past.
Lumberjack Will is attracted to the spoiled daughter of his boss, Mr. Bell.
A convict is released from prison — but not from his past.
A thief outwits lawmen by returning to his rundown shack, which straddles the U.S.–Republic of Texas border.
Three orphaned children continue their parents' quest for gold.
A goat and some biscuits save a family from death.
A Mormon leader is determined to enforce God's law with a gun.
A physician courts disaster by aiding one of two feuding Natives.
After a trip to town, two miners find gold nuggets mixed with beans they bought.
A peace-seeking Native scout aids pioneers besieged by Native renegades.
A trouble-shooter must establish a mail route in bandit country.
A young man hunts for gold, hoping to impress his girl so she'll accept his proposal.
A woman flirts with a ranch hand while waiting for a proposal from her beau despite her grandma's warning.
Wagon master Caleb must bring his wayward son Johnny to justice after the boy goes too far.
This tale of misadventure focuses on Frank Baum's penning of 'The Wonderful Wizard of Oz.'
Maso and Okei, tea growers in Gold Hills, encounter both friendship and racism from the locals.
Postal inspector Wesley Hull is determined to discover how postmaster Reardon can sell so many stamps.
Natives reject the doctrines of Christianity in this biographical tale of missionary priest Jean Baptiste Lamy.
There's more than gold in store for prim Wilhelmina Vail when she tackles a claim in rugged Utah territory.
A cowboy and a Native man join forces to secure dowries for their sweethearts.
After Mark contracts typhoid fever and has a vision of his dead mother he no longer seems interested in getting well.
An old friend of Lucas's returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.
A dying man offers Josh $2000 to find his son, who ran away from home 15 years ago.
Josh and Jason are escorting four prisoners - three men and one woman - to Leavenworth prison when a stranger begins following along behind asking to travel with the group for protection.
Josh is summoned for help when the Pinto bank is robbed.
Josh expects a $400 bounty for bringing in Daniel Trenner but finds his prisoner stolen from him by the sheriff.
Josh is hired by a woman to sober up Harry a drunk who is also Josh's friend.
Josh and the beautiful female prisoner he is transporting to trial are on a three-day trip while her partner is still on the loose in the area.
Josh is on his way to River City to transport three convicts there to be hanged.
A dance hall singer asks Lucas to care for her daughter in an effort to hide the baby from her self-righteous, bigoted father.
Lucas becomes involved in a battle between an aspiring writer and a cocky, bragging trail boss.
Mark runs away from home after his father questions his story about overhearing a plot to rob the bank.
A famous buffalo hunter tries to goad Lucas into a shooting match. When Lucas refuses, he becomes the new target.
When a stranger arrives to marry the town spinster, two brothers who want her land try to discourage him with threats and a beating.
Mark finds himself in grave danger when two unscrupulous detectives searching for a man's long-lost son claim that it's Mark.
A priest claims the marriages in a town are void.
A prospector helps a dentist who has been beaten and robbed by bandits.
